detail.longDescription: Sandcat - a # Docker & dev container setup for securely running AI agents in `--dangerous` mode - has a brand new documentation page! The project gained quite a lot of features recently, including: * multiple agent support (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot) * network rules presets * JVM dependency caching in a single volume * devbox-managed third-party dependencies * support for resolving intranet services via customisable DNS settings
